name: list-constructor-spread-operator-test-ae223889d2/spread-operator-negative-e.bal
reason: The case asserts compile-time rejection of undefined spread operands, non-list operands, incompatible array/tuple element types, and incompatible fixed or varying list lengths, including aliases and missing required tuple members. These are type-checking behaviors of supported list constructors, variable references, declarations and type definitions. The specification places no restriction on spread members of list constructors; its spread-field exclusion applies specifically to mapping constructors. No essential unsupported construct is present.
test_design_notes: Negative compilation case: @error annotations assert rejection; the two // OK initializers provide valid alias-based spread contexts.
Covers open, fixed-length and inferred-length arrays, tuple rest members, unions, singleton types, filler constraints and type aliases.
